title: DJ Villar Geometric Mosaic Post (Full View)
whatItIs: The full view of the DJ post on a sage-green backdrop with a soft drop shadow: a duotone portrait, a coral, teal and cream gradient mosaic of discs, arrows and a starburst, and a navy text panel with a name, genres, a line of text and a URL.
whatItMeans: Seeing the complete layout shows how the quiet sage backdrop makes the coral and teal mosaic pop.
techniques: Sage backdrop to present the post
Portrait and mosaic sharing one colour range
Panel with thin rules framing the genre line
Socials at the lower left on cream
